def entry(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf) -> u32:
    if length(s) != 24:
        return 4294967295
    if read64(s, 0) != 3544422311941722696 or read64(s, 8) != 1 or read64(s, 16) != 0:
        return 4294967295
    if length(o) < 3487:
        return 4294967294
    part_0(o)
    part_1(o)
    part_2(o)
    part_3(o)
    part_4(o)
    part_5(o)
    part_6(o)
    return 3487
